description: Percent-encode and decode URL strings. Operations: "encode" — Percent-encode a string.; "decode" — Decode a percent-encoded string.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: encode: The text to encode. decode: The encoded text to decode.

operation.description: encode — Percent-encode a string. decode — Decode a percent-encoded string.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

level.description: encode: How many times to encode. decode: How many times to decode. Used by: encode, decode.

name: url-encode
title: Batch URL Encoder & Parser
